# CRRT

> CRRT turns visual feedback on web products into working code changes. Humans review feedback and resulting fixes; coding agents work on accepted feedback through scoped handoffs.

## When to use CRRT

Use CRRT when a human has shared accepted visual feedback about a web product and wants a coding agent to implement it in the relevant repository. The React widget captures the target element or text range and comment; the dashboard supports review and agent handoff.

A human must create the handoff and provide its share slug and scoped token. Announce presence, read state, work only on accepted comments, claim before editing, report progress, and refresh state between items. Humans own review status. Do not merge changes solely because an agent operation reports completion.

## Documentation

- [Install CRRT](https://crrt.ai/docs/install): React widget setup and configuration.
- [CRRT Agent API and authentication](https://crrt.ai/docs/agent-handoff): Scoped share tokens, lifecycle, and HTTP examples.
- [Self-host CRRT](https://crrt.ai/docs/self-host): Deployment and infrastructure setup.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://crrt.ai/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 contract for the existing authenticated agent share API.
- [Design skill](https://crrt.ai/skill.md): Design guidance for UI-related handoffs only.

- [How to prototype with Lovable and review the result](https://crrt.ai/resources/lovable-prototype-review-workflow): A focused prototype brief and a repeatable refinement loop.
- [How to prototype in v0 with your design system](https://crrt.ai/resources/v0-prototyping-with-your-design-system): A reusable v0 brief that keeps your existing system in view.
- [How to report responsive UI issues precisely](https://crrt.ai/resources/report-responsive-ui-issues): A responsive issue report someone else can reproduce.
- [How to run a focused 15-minute prototype review](https://crrt.ai/resources/focused-prototype-review): A short agenda that ends with decisions and clear ownership.
- [How to compare a design frame with a browser screenshot](https://crrt.ai/resources/compare-design-to-browser): A comparison protocol that separates real drift from setup differences.
- [How to review light and dark color themes together](https://crrt.ai/resources/review-light-and-dark-themes): A paired-theme review matrix with explicit checks.
- [What belongs in a minimum viable design system?](https://crrt.ai/resources/minimum-viable-design-system): A small system you can apply and review in a real flow.
- [How to record design decisions so coding agents preserve intent](https://crrt.ai/resources/design-decisions-for-coding-agents): A decision record that explains the reason behind a design rule.
- [How to scope one visual fix for a coding agent](https://crrt.ai/resources/scope-a-visual-fix): A bounded implementation brief with a clear review point.
- [How to find missing states in AI-generated forms](https://crrt.ai/resources/review-ai-generated-forms): A form-state matrix and a focused correction prompt.
- [How to organize a Storybook design review](https://crrt.ai/resources/storybook-design-review): A component review plan that stays connected to the product.
- [How to verify a UI fix before marking feedback resolved](https://crrt.ai/resources/verify-a-ui-fix): A resolution record that connects the change to its evidence.
- [How to onboard a client to their first prototype review](https://crrt.ai/resources/client-prototype-review): A client review invitation with clear questions and boundaries.
- [Visual feedback vs visual regression testing: when to use each](https://crrt.ai/resources/visual-feedback-vs-visual-regression): A practical way to combine human judgment with screenshot checks.
- [Text contrast checker for UI color pairs](https://crrt.ai/resources/text-contrast-checker): Check a color pair and copy a precise review note.
- [px to rem converter with an adjustable root size](https://crrt.ai/resources/px-to-rem-converter): Convert a value using the root size your project actually uses.
- [Visual feedback brief builder](https://crrt.ai/resources/visual-feedback-brief-builder): Build a clear, copyable UI change request.

## Access and formats

Send the share token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Presence and operations also require a stable X-Agent-Id; operations require Idempotency-Key. Do not put tokens in public links or logs. Missing or invalid credentials return 401, missing shares return 404, and expired or revoked shares return 410.

Request public pages with Accept: text/markdown to receive Markdown at the same URL. Plain Markdown copies are also available by appending .md to documentation paths; the homepage is /index.md. CRRT MCP is available over Streamable HTTP at /api/mcp/v1 with account authorization and scoped read, implementation, and review permissions. See /docs/agent-handoff for setup. The HTTP Agent API remains available for scoped shares.
